intro: A mobile, height-adjustable table built for flexible and collaborative workstyles — perfect for small and medium offices that thrive on movement and adaptability

features.title: Effortless Height Adjustment
features.text: Allows smooth and easy height changes to suit different postures and working styles — from quick stand-up discussions to seated tasks.

features.title: Lightweight and Mobile Design
features.text: Equipped with smooth-rolling castors, it can be moved around effortlessly, adapting to evolving team needs and workspace layouts.

features.title: Screen Mount Provision
features.text: Built to support screen attachment, allowing added privacy or acoustic functionality when paired with compatible screen units

features.title: Designed for Dynamic Collaboration
features.text: Encourages interaction, flexibility, and agile working — ideal for meeting corners, breakout spaces, or compact offices.

features.title: Space-Smart & Individual Focus
features.text: Optimally sized for single-user use, it fits easily into small and medium office setups, offering comfort without occupying excess space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Float 800 X 450 Height Adjustable Table
